Container.Name: Yoink
Container.Overview: Yoink is a self-hosted silent auction. Guests scan an item's QR code, sign in and bid from their phone; each item is its own listing with its own start and end time. Admins manage items, users, QR code sheets and bid history; a server admin looks after branding, email (SMTP) and admin invites.[br][br]Uses your own PostgreSQL database (14 or newer): create an empty database and user first and put them in Database URL. Database migrations run automatically every time the container starts.[br][br]First run: open the WebUI and create the server admin account (always the first account), who then invites the admins who run the auction.
Container.Requires: An external PostgreSQL 14+ database reachable from this container, with an empty database and a user that owns it. A reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Caddy or Traefik) with HTTPS if Yoink is reachable from the internet.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web app. Point your reverse proxy here.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Uploaded files (item photos, logos, profile pictures) and installed themes, in uploads and themes folders inside. Include it in your backups along with the database.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Your PostgreSQL connection string: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:5432/DATABASE . URL-encode special characters in the password (@ is %40, # is %23, / is %2F). Add ?sslmode=require if your server needs SSL.

Config.Name: Public web address
Config.Description: The address guests' phones will open, e.g. https://auction.yourdomain.com or http://YOUR-UNRAID-IP:3000 on a LAN. Printed QR codes, invite links and email links all point here, so set it before printing codes.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: A long random string (16+ characters) that encrypts the stored SMTP password. Generate one in the Unraid terminal: openssl rand -base64 32 . Changing it later means re-entering the SMTP password on the Server page.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: true when Yoink is served over HTTPS (behind a reverse proxy). false when guests use plain http on your LAN (http://IP:3000), otherwise sign-in won't stick.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: The venue's time zone. Used for times in emails and for when the daily new-items email is sent.

Config.Name: Registration access code (optional)
Config.Description: Optional. If set, guests must enter this code to create their own account (e.g. a word printed on the event table). Leave empty to let anyone register while registration is open.

Config.Name: Themes folder
Config.Description: Where themes installed from the Server page are kept inside the container. Leave as /data/themes so they land in App data above (built-in themes ship with the app).

Config.Name: Uploads folder
Config.Description: Where uploads are written inside the container. Leave as /data/uploads so they land in App data above.
